method: Read all 80 final responses and emitted call lists. A channel request asks which channel is intended or asks permission to use an additional channel, including imperative invitations such as tell me if. Mere channel mentions and descriptions of a completed diagnostics request do not count. Postwrite requests include optional customer-email offers and never count as incident-free clarification. The explicit run lists record this reading, rather than deriving questions from incident labels or the raw heuristic.
